g.text: Crash and resume at each boundary of the payment pipeline
(fault points for test/fault/; C4, C5, C6, C13, C21, C23; nonce-and-crash spike: 127 of 127 kill runs paid once)
K2 after signing, before the start commit (wallet:signed)
payment Queued; bytes only in the dead signer
sign again (same bytes: extraEntropy false); nothing burnt
K3 after the start commit, before broadcast (wallet:stored)
Signed, version {raw, hash}, nonce n burnt
K4 mid-broadcast or after it, Sent not recorded (wallet:broadcast)
rebroadcast: "already known" or "nonce too low", then the receipt
K5 after a receipt was read, before its commit (wallet:receipt)
append-only: rebroadcast every stored version, newest first
the start commit must have survived
per-commit sync before the effect (C21); else the lane freezes
[chain count == ledger, or the difference is explained by stored hashes]
[unexplained count above the ledger at latest]
nonce · lane_turn [chain_ahead] → blocked; blocked · finality [above_final] → free
Resume, by what the last commit holds
payment Queued · crash → Queued; nonce signing · crash → free
Signed · broadcast → Sent; Sent · broadcast → Sent
payment Sent · crash → Sent; nonce in_flight · crash → in_flight
[the nonce was used by a transaction the store does not hold]
x402 boundaries: after the authorization commit and before signing, re-signing gives the same authorization (derived nonce);
after signing and before the header reaches the box, the stored header is handed (authorized · crash → authorized).
Shared invariants after every kill: at most one signed transaction per (wallet, nonce) banda chose; no stored bytes without
a ledger entry; no entry left Signed without the follower; nothing reported "did not run" while its bytes are stored.
